visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a long, flowing white dress, walks along the narrow edge of an infinity pool. Her reflection is visible in the still water. Behind her, the vast ocean meets a clear sky, with the sun low on the horizon casting a bright glare across the water. (2) Two hands are held up against the background of a brightly lit airport jet bridge, showcasing a green Taiwan passport and a red Japan passport. The lighting is artificial and industrial. (3) The woman stands in a modern airport terminal lobby, wearing a black tank top and olive green trousers, smiling warmly at the camera. The background shows airport signage and blurred passengers. (4) A series of quick cuts show the woman jumping into a pool in an orange bikini, then walking away from the camera down a wooden pier at a luxury resort. The pier is covered by a roof with solar panels, surrounded by turquoise water. (5) In a shallow ocean, two figures sit on a wooden swing set. This transitions to an underwater view where several tropical fish and a large stingray swim over a sandy seabed in clear blue water. (6) The woman is shown at night, eating from a white bowl by a pool illuminated with blue light. Close-up shots show a plate of skewered food, followed by two people clinking beer glasses against a sunset ocean backdrop. (7) The woman practices breathing exercises on a yoga mat by the beach, then sits in a pool with a floating breakfast tray. Large white Chinese text with an orange background appears at the bottom as a final promotional call to action.
